name: EnlaZAR - Iberian Love Story
source:
You’ve just moved to the city of Zaragoza with your mother and your dog Goya. How many adventures will you experience over the course of six months? Will you meet your soulmate in this city? Find out in EnlaZAR!

[Translated from [url=https://pink-pixel-3.itch.io/enlazar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚带着爱犬戈雅，随母亲一同搬到了萨拉戈萨市。在接下来的六个月里，你将经历多少奇妙的冒险？你能否在这座城市里邂逅命中注定的灵魂伴侣？一切尽在《EnlaZAR》中揭晓！

[译自[url=https://pink-pixel-3.itch.io/enlazar]itch.io[/url]]
